================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/dh_particle.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}

uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform vec4 ColorModulator;
uniform mat4 DhInvViewProjMat;
uniform vec2 ScreenSize;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform float ThermalCapture;
uniform float EmissiveSpark;
uniform int CookoffFireCount;
uniform float CookoffFirePos[12];
uniform float CookoffFireEnergyRadius[8];
uniform int CookoffCount;
uniform float CookoffPos[192];
uniform float CookoffEnergyRadius[128];
flat in int cookoffIndex;
uniform int MotorCount;
uniform float MotorPos[12];
uniform float MotorJet[12];
uniform float MotorEnergyRadius[8];

in vec2 texCoord;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec4 lightMapColor;
in vec3 cameraRelativePos;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
    vec4 sprite = texture(Sampler0, texCoord);
    vec4 color = sprite * vertexColor * ColorModulator * lightMapColor;
    if(EmissiveSpark > 0.5 && ThermalCapture < 0.5) {
        color = sprite * vertexColor * ColorModulator;
        float core = max(sprite.r, max(sprite.g, sprite.b));
        float hot = smoothstep(0.08, 0.40, vertexColor.g);
        color.rgb *= EmissiveSpark > 2.5 ? 2.1 + max(0.0,EmissiveSpark-3.0)*3.5 : EmissiveSpark > 1.5 ? 3.5 + (7.0 + 10.0 * hot) * core * core
                                       : 1.8 + 3.2 * core * core;
        // LDR clamps radiance before blending. Encode extra night light in
        // the additive source weight, otherwise brighter RGB never reaches the scene.
        if(EmissiveSpark > 2.5) color.a=min(1.0,color.a*(1.0+clamp(EmissiveSpark-3.0,0.0,1.0)*.65));
        // Keep the warm chroma when writing to an LDR scene buffer. Independently
        // clipped red/green used to turn even orange SAM streaks flat yellow.
        if(EmissiveSpark > 1.5) {
            float peak=max(color.r,max(color.g,color.b));
            color.rgb*=min(1.0,(EmissiveSpark > 2.5 ? 1.45 + max(0.0,EmissiveSpark-3.0)*.85 : 1.6)/max(peak,0.001));
        }
    }
    if (ThermalCapture > 0.5 && vertexColor.r > 0.5
            && vertexColor.g < vertexColor.r * 0.4
            && vertexColor.b < vertexColor.r * 0.45) {
        // Decode BEFORE sprite multiplication and alpha blending. Visible-light
        // albedo/lightmap must not reduce the temperature of hot gas or metal.
        float temperature = clamp(1.0 - (vertexColor.g / vertexColor.r - 0.02) / 0.32, 0.0, 1.0);
        float structure = dot(sprite.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
        float density = smoothstep(0.025, 0.60, structure);
        float incandescent = smoothstep(0.94, 0.995, temperature);
        // Cooler edges and hot dense folds use the sprite's own structure;
        // no screen-space noise pattern that swims when the camera moves.
        float localHeat = temperature * mix(0.60 + 0.40 * density, 1.0, incandescent);
        color.rgb = vec3(1.0, mix(0.34, 0.02, localHeat), mix(0.10, 0.01, localHeat));
        // Preserve the original silhouette and fade. The bright interior carries
        // radiance independently of dark RGB texels, while edges stay translucent.
        color.a = sprite.a * vertexColor.a * ColorModulator.a;
    }
    if (color.a < 0.004) discard;

    // Shade once, BEFORE alpha compositing. Near dust attenuates the complete
    // radiance of the plume behind it, including its engine illumination.
    if(ThermalCapture < 0.5 && EmissiveSpark < 0.5
            && (MotorCount > 0 || (cookoffIndex >= 0 && (CookoffCount > 0 || CookoffFireCount > 0)))) {
        float density=dot(sprite.rgb,vec3(0.3333))*sprite.a;
        vec3 facing=normalize(-cameraRelativePos+vec3(1e-8));
        vec3 normal=normalize(facing-normalize(dFdx(cameraRelativePos)+vec3(1e-8))*dFdx(density)*18.0
            -normalize(dFdy(cameraRelativePos)+vec3(1e-8))*dFdy(density)*18.0);
        // Same relief/scattering calculation as powered motor smoke, applied
        // only to the tagged cookoff wake and its own interpolated source.
        if(cookoffIndex>=0 && cookoffIndex<CookoffCount){
            int i=cookoffIndex;
            vec3 emitter=vec3(CookoffPos[i*3],CookoffPos[i*3+1],CookoffPos[i*3+2]);
            vec3 delta=emitter-cameraRelativePos;
            float radius=max(1.0,CookoffEnergyRadius[i*2+1]);
            float attenuation=1.0/pow(1.0+dot(delta,delta)/(radius*radius),2.0);
            vec3 toLight=delta/max(length(delta),.001);
            float relief=.16+max(dot(normal,toLight),0.0)*.64
                +pow(max(dot(-facing,toLight),0.0),3.0)*(1.0-sprite.a*.65)*.20;
            color.rgb+=mix(vec3(1.0,.38,.10),vec3(1.0,.75,.35),attenuation)
                *CookoffEnergyRadius[i*2]*attenuation*relief*.65;
        }
        if(cookoffIndex>=0)for(int i=0;i<4;i++){
            if(i>=CookoffFireCount)break;
            vec3 emitter=vec3(CookoffFirePos[i*3],CookoffFirePos[i*3+1],CookoffFirePos[i*3+2]);
            vec3 delta=emitter-cameraRelativePos;
            float radius=max(1.0,CookoffFireEnergyRadius[i*2+1]);
            float attenuation=1.0/pow(1.0+dot(delta,delta)/(radius*radius),2.0);
            vec3 toLight=delta/max(length(delta),.001);
            float relief=.16+max(dot(normal,toLight),0.0)*.64
                +pow(max(dot(-facing,toLight),0.0),3.0)*(1.0-sprite.a*.65)*.20;
            color.rgb+=vec3(1.0,.42,.08)*CookoffFireEnergyRadius[i*2]*attenuation*relief*.65;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<4;i++){
            if(i>=MotorCount)break;
            vec3 emitter=vec3(MotorPos[i*3],MotorPos[i*3+1],MotorPos[i*3+2]);
            vec3 jet=vec3(MotorJet[i*3],MotorJet[i*3+1],MotorJet[i*3+2]);
            float t=clamp(dot(cameraRelativePos-emitter,jet)/max(dot(jet,jet),.0001),0.0,1.0);
            vec3 delta=emitter+jet*t-cameraRelativePos;
            float radius=max(1.0,MotorEnergyRadius[i*2+1]);
            float attenuation=1.0/pow(1.0+dot(delta,delta)/(radius*radius),2.0);
            vec3 toLight=delta/max(length(delta),.001);
            float relief=.16+max(dot(normal,toLight),0.0)*.64
                +pow(max(dot(-facing,toLight),0.0),3.0)*(1.0-sprite.a*.65)*.20;
            color.rgb+=mix(vec3(1.0,.59,.27),vec3(1.0,.91,.76),attenuation)
                *MotorEnergyRadius[i*2]*attenuation*relief*.65;
        }
    }

    if (HasDhDepth > 0.5) {
        vec2 screenUv = gl_FragCoord.xy / max(ScreenSize, vec2(1.0));
        float dhDepth = texture(DhDepthSampler, screenUv).r;
        if (cmDhSurface(dhDepth)) {
            vec4 clip = vec4(screenUv * 2.0 - 1.0, dhDepth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
            vec4 dhH = DhInvViewProjMat * clip;
            vec3 dhPos = dhH.xyz / max(abs(dhH.w), 1e-6);
            // DH depth becomes progressively less precise at kilometre ranges.
            // A fixed sub-block bias made distant billboards disappear head-on
            // and reappear at the screen edge. Scale only the precision allowance;
            // geometry that is materially behind a LOD surface is still rejected.
            float particleDistance = length(cameraRelativePos);
            float depthTolerance = clamp(1.25 + particleDistance * 0.0045, 1.25, 12.0);
            if (length(dhPos) + depthTolerance < particleDistance) discard;
        }
    }

    fragColor = color;
}

#version 150

in vec3 Position;
in vec2 UV0;
in vec4 Color;
in ivec2 UV2;

uniform sampler2D Sampler2;
uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;

out vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 vertexColor;
out vec4 lightMapColor;
out vec3 cameraRelativePos;
flat out int cookoffIndex;

void main() {
    gl_Position = ProjMat * ModelViewMat * vec4(Position, 1.0);
    texCoord = UV0;
    vertexColor = Color;
    cookoffIndex=UV2.x>=256?UV2.x-256:-1;
    lightMapColor = cookoffIndex>=0?vec4(1.0):texelFetch(Sampler2, UV2 / 16, 0);
    cameraRelativePos = Position;
}


================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/explosion_light.fsh

#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}

uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;
uniform sampler2D DepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;

uniform mat4 InvViewProjMat;
uniform mat4 ViewProjMat;
uniform mat4 DhInvViewProjMat;
uniform mat4 DhViewProjMat;
uniform mat4 InvProjMat;
uniform mat4 ViewToWorldMat;
uniform vec3 LightPos;
uniform vec3 LightColor;
uniform vec3 LightAxis;
uniform vec3 LightPrevPos;
uniform float Intensity;
uniform float SkyIntensity;
uniform float FlashIntensity;
uniform float Radius;
uniform float SkyRadius;
uniform float AirBurst;
uniform float PointSource;
uniform float LightCount;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform float HasDhMatrix;
uniform float DhOnly;
uniform float SamNight;
uniform float SamPos[12];
uniform float SamPrev[12];
uniform float SamCol[12];
uniform float SamAxis[12];
uniform float SamIntRadius[8];
uniform float SamSpark[8];
// Minecraft uploads a float uniform with count=4 as a vec4, not a scalar array.
uniform vec4 SamMotorScale;

in vec2 texCoord;

out vec4 fragColor;

float distToCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b) {
    vec3 ab = b - a;
    float ab2 = max(dot(ab, ab), 1e-6);
    float t = clamp(dot(p - a, ab) / ab2, 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(p - (a + ab * t));
}

// Min distance from ray (origin 0, dir rd) to segment a→b — world-locked spark (no camera swim)
float raySegmentDist(vec3 rd, vec3 a, vec3 b) {
    vec3 u = b - a;
    vec3 v = rd;
    vec3 w = a;
    float uu = max(dot(u, u), 1e-8);
    float vv = max(dot(v, v), 1e-8);
    float uv = dot(u, v);
    float wu = dot(w, u);
    float wv = dot(w, v);
    float D = uu * vv - uv * uv;
    float tSeg;
    float tRay;
    if (D < 1e-8) {
        tSeg = clamp(-wu / uu, 0.0, 1.0);
        tRay = max(dot(a + u * tSeg, v) / vv, 0.0);
    } else {
        tSeg = clamp((uv * wv - vv * wu) / D, 0.0, 1.0);
        tRay = max((uu * wv - uv * wu) / D, 0.0);
    }
    vec3 pSeg = a + u * tSeg;
    vec3 pRay = v * tRay;
    return length(pSeg - pRay);
}

vec3 samVec3(float arr[12], int i) {
    int o = i * 3;
    return vec3(arr[o], arr[o + 1], arr[o + 2]);
}

float depthOcclusionAt(vec3 samplePos, mat4 viewProj, mat4 invViewProj,
                       sampler2D depthSampler, float worldBias, bool distant) {
    vec4 projected = viewProj * vec4(samplePos, 1.0);
    if (projected.w <= 1e-5) return 0.0;
    vec3 ndc = projected.xyz / projected.w;
    vec2 uv = ndc.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
    if (uv.x <= 0.002 || uv.x >= 0.998 || uv.y <= 0.002 || uv.y >= 0.998) return 0.0;
    float expectedDepth = ndc.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
    if (expectedDepth <= 0.0 || expectedDepth >= 1.0) return 0.0;
    float sceneDepth = texture(depthSampler, uv).r;
    if (distant ? !cmDhSurface(sceneDepth) : sceneDepth>=0.99999) return 0.0;

    // Depth is highly non-linear: a fixed depth-buffer epsilon at 500-1000
    // blocks can hide an entire house. Reconstruct the visible sample and
    // compare camera-relative distances in actual blocks instead.
    vec4 sceneH = invViewProj * vec4(uv * 2.0 - 1.0,
            sceneDepth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
    vec3 scenePos = sceneH.xyz / max(abs(sceneH.w), 1e-6);
    float expectedDistance = length(samplePos);
    float sceneDistance = length(scenePos);
    return sceneDistance + worldBias < expectedDistance ? 1.0 : 0.0;
}

// Approximate light-to-surface visibility using both Minecraft and DH depth.
// A multi-sample ray gives stable house/wall shadows without a second
// world render or a cubemap shadow pass for every explosion.
float explosionVisibility(vec3 surfacePos, vec3 emitterPos) {
    vec3 segment = emitterPos - surfacePos;
    float segmentLength = length(segment);
    if (segmentLength < 2.0) return 1.0;
    float blocked = 0.0;
    // 24 samples are dense enough not to step over a 4-6 block village house
    // on the long rays seen in the tactical test recordings.
    for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
        float t = 0.07 + (float(i) + 0.5) * (0.86 / 24.0);
        vec3 samplePos = surfacePos + segment * t;
        float hit = depthOcclusionAt(samplePos, ViewProjMat, InvViewProjMat,
                DepthSampler, 0.55, false);
        if (HasDhDepth > 0.5 && HasDhMatrix > 0.5) {
            hit = max(hit, depthOcclusionAt(samplePos, DhViewProjMat, DhInvViewProjMat,
                    DhDepthSampler, 1.35, true));
        }
        blocked += hit;
    }
    // One or two samples may be a thin wall, so they must already make a
    // readable shadow. Never make it pitch black: the huge fireball produces
    // a broad penumbra and the illuminated ground supplies bounced light.
    return 1.0 - smoothstep(0.35, 2.8, blocked) * 0.88;
}

void main() {
    vec4 scene = texture(DiffuseSampler, texCoord);
    float depth = texture(DepthSampler, texCoord).r;
    float dhDepth = HasDhDepth > 0.5 ? texture(DhDepthSampler, texCoord).r : 1.0;
    bool vanSky = depth >= 0.99999;
    // Only real DH geometry behind sky-depth. Do NOT color-guess:
    // dark night sky has low skyLikeness and was misclassified as terrain →
    // launch pad wash flooded the whole sky and killed the nozzle spark.
    bool dhHit = HasDhDepth > 0.5 && cmDhSurface(dhDepth);
    bool lodSurface = vanSky && dhHit;
    bool isSky = vanSky && !lodSurface;

    if (DhOnly > 0.5 && !lodSurface) {
        fragColor = scene;
        return;
    }

    float surfaceDepth = lodSurface ? dhDepth : depth;
    vec4 clip = vec4(
        texCoord.x * 2.0 - 1.0,
        texCoord.y * 2.0 - 1.0,
        surfaceDepth * 2.0 - 1.0,
        1.0
    );
    vec4 worldH = (lodSurface && HasDhMatrix > 0.5)
        ? (DhInvViewProjMat * clip) : (InvViewProjMat * clip);
    vec3 camRel = worldH.xyz / max(worldH.w, 1e-6);

    float luma = dot(scene.rgb, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    float nightGap = clamp(1.25 - luma * 1.2, 0.2, 1.0);
    vec3 add = vec3(0.0);

    int count = int(LightCount + 0.5);

    // --- SAM batch: soft ground wash + tiny world-space nozzle spark ---
    if (count > 0) {
        // Ray in the SAME space as camRel / SamPos (camera-relative world).
        // Using InvProj+ViewToWorld drifted under view-bob and made the spark swim.
        vec4 nearH = InvViewProjMat * vec4(clip.xy, -1.0, 1.0);
        vec4 farH = InvViewProjMat * vec4(clip.xy, 1.0, 1.0);
        vec3 nearP = nearH.xyz / max(nearH.w, 1e-6);
        vec3 farP = farH.xyz / max(farH.w, 1e-6);
        vec3 rayDir = normalize(farP - nearP);

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (i >= count) {
                break;
            }
            vec3 pos = samVec3(SamPos, i);
            vec3 prev = samVec3(SamPrev, i);
            vec3 col = samVec3(SamCol, i);
            vec3 axis = samVec3(SamAxis, i);
            float inten = SamIntRadius[i * 2];
            float rad = max(SamIntRadius[i * 2 + 1], 4.0);
            float sparkInt = SamSpark[i * 2];
            float sparkLen = max(SamSpark[i * 2 + 1], 0.4);

            // Soft pad wash (terrain only) — backup «зенитной ракетой в2»
            if (!isSky && inten >= 0.01) {
                vec3 jetEnd = pos + normalize(axis) * sparkLen;
                float d = distToCapsule(camRel, pos, jetEnd);
                float core = 1.0 / (1.0 + (d / (rad * 0.55)) * (d / (rad * 0.55)));
                float mid = 1.0 / (1.0 + (d / rad) * (d / rad));
                float skirt = 1.0 / (1.0 + (d / (rad * 1.85)) * (d / (rad * 1.85)));
                // A rational falloff never reaches zero. Without this boundary
                // every terrain pixel received launch color and the view became
                // one flat yellow/grey layer.
                float finiteRange = 1.0 - smoothstep(rad * 1.15, rad * 2.05, d);
                float fall = max(core * 0.55, max(mid * 0.70, skirt * 0.28)) * finiteRange;
                float lit = inten * fall * nightGap;
                vec3 surfaceNormal = normalize(cross(dFdx(camRel), dFdy(camRel)));
                if (dot(surfaceNormal, -rayDir) < 0.0) surfaceNormal = -surfaceNormal;
                vec3 toEmitter = normalize(mix(pos, jetEnd, 0.45) - camRel);
                float facing = 0.22 + 0.78 * max(dot(surfaceNormal, toEmitter), 0.0);
                // Retain terrain texture and hue instead of laying a flat white wash over it.
                vec3 daylight = (scene.rgb * 1.8 + vec3(0.055)) * col * lit * facing;
                // One smooth distance law for terrain, vehicles and walls.
                // No launch-age boundary: low flight keeps lighting nearby geometry.
                float nightFall = 1.0 / pow(1.0 + d * d / (rad * rad), 2.0);
                vec3 nightColor = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.59, 0.27), vec3(1.0, 0.87, 0.66), nightFall);
                vec3 nightLight = (scene.rgb * 1.7 + vec3(0.095)) * nightColor
                                * inten * nightFall * facing;
                add += mix(daylight, nightLight, SamNight);
            }

            // Tiny elongated nozzle spark — world-locked in camera-relative space
            if (sparkInt >= 0.01) {
                float axLen = length(axis);
                vec3 ex = axLen > 1e-4 ? axis / axLen : vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
                float surfaceT = isSky ? 1e8 : max(dot(camRel, rayDir), 0.0);
                float hot = 0.0;
                float rim = 0.0;
                float haze = 0.0;
                // Overlapping depth-tested cross sections of a widening jet.
                // The same ray test works against sky AND terrain backgrounds.
                for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                    float u = float(j) / 15.0;
                    vec3 centre = pos + ex * (sparkLen * u);
                    float rayT = dot(centre, rayDir);
                    if (rayT <= 0.0) continue;
                    vec3 closest = rayDir * min(rayT, surfaceT);
                    float d = length(closest - centre);
                    float width = 0.18 * max(1.0, SamMotorScale[i]) + 0.095 * sparkLen * u;
                    float tail = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.65, 1.0, u);
                    // Jet width softens its silhouette, not scene occlusion.
                    // Letting width extend depth made the core bleed through the missile.
                    float visible = isSky ? 1.0 : 1.0 - smoothstep(surfaceT, surfaceT + 0.03, rayT);
                    float body = exp(-d * d / (width * width));
                    float edge = exp(-d * d / (width * width * 2.8));
                    hot = max(hot, body * tail * visible);
                    rim = max(rim, edge * tail * visible);
                    // Local atmospheric scattering: finite, occluded, also visible
                    // against sky. This is a nearby halo, not a uniform sky flash.
                    float hazeRadius = 2.0 + width * 3.5;
                    float fog = exp(-d * d / (hazeRadius * hazeRadius));
                    float fogVisible = isSky ? 1.0 : 1.0 - smoothstep(surfaceT, surfaceT + hazeRadius, rayT);
                    haze = max(haze, fog * fogVisible * (1.0 - smoothstep(hazeRadius, hazeRadius * 2.0, d)));
                }
                float nearFade = smoothstep(0.6, 2.5, length(pos));
                add += vec3(1.0, 0.98, 0.91) * hot * sparkInt * 2.8 * nearFade;
                add += vec3(1.0, 0.47, 0.12) * max(rim - hot * 0.75, 0.0) * sparkInt * 0.85 * nearFade;
                add += vec3(1.0, 0.59, 0.23) * haze * sparkInt * nightGap * 0.12 * nearFade * (1.0 - SamNight);
                // Soft distant optical bloom, bounded in world units: it still shrinks far away.
                vec3 bloomAt = pos + ex * sparkLen * 0.35;
                float bloomDistance = length(bloomAt);
                float bloomT = dot(bloomAt, rayDir);
                float bloomVisible = isSky ? 1.0 : 1.0 - smoothstep(surfaceT, surfaceT + 0.03, bloomT);
                if (bloomT > 0.0) {
                    float radius = min(8.0, 1.5 + bloomDistance * 0.006);
                    float d = length(rayDir * bloomT - bloomAt) / radius;
                    float bloom = exp(-d*d*1.6) + 0.15*exp(-d*d*0.4);
                    float gain = smoothstep(100.0, 350.0, bloomDistance) * sparkInt * bloomVisible;
                    add += vec3(1.0, 0.91, 0.68) * bloom * gain * mix(0.18, 0.65, SamNight);
                }
            }
            if (SamNight > 0.001 && DhOnly < 0.5 && inten > 0.001) {
                // Integrate illuminated air along the view ray, clipped at the
                // first scene surface. The glow has real world size and parallax.
                vec3 centre = pos + axis * sparkLen * 0.45;
                float fogRadius = rad * 0.48;
                float along = dot(centre, rayDir);
                float perpendicular2 = max(dot(centre, centre) - along * along, 0.0);
                float bound2 = 9.0 * fogRadius * fogRadius;
                if (perpendicular2 < bound2) {
                    float halfSpan = sqrt(bound2 - perpendicular2);
                    float startT = max(along - halfSpan, 0.0);
                    float endT = along + halfSpan;
                    if (!isSky) endT = min(endT, max(dot(camRel, rayDir), 0.0));
                    float stepLength = max(endT - startT, 0.0) / 12.0;
                    float opticalDepth = 0.0;
                    for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 12; sampleIndex++) {
                        vec3 p = rayDir * (startT + (float(sampleIndex) + 0.5) * stepLength);
                        float r2 = dot(p - centre, p - centre) / (fogRadius * fogRadius);
                        opticalDepth += exp(-r2 * 1.4) * stepLength / fogRadius;
                    }
                    float scattering = (1.0 - exp(-opticalDepth * 0.22)) * inten * SamNight * 0.25;
                    add += vec3(1.0, 0.64, 0.34) * scattering;
                }
            }
        }
        fragColor = vec4(scene.rgb + add, scene.a);
        return;
    }

    // --- Legacy single-light path (explosions / old callers) ---
    // Build the ray in exactly the same camera-relative world space as
    // LightPos and camRel.  InvProj + Camera.rotation omitted Minecraft's
    // view-bob transform, so a world-fixed blast appeared to sway with the
    // player's camera animation.
    vec4 explosionNearH = InvViewProjMat * vec4(clip.xy, -1.0, 1.0);
    vec4 explosionFarH = InvViewProjMat * vec4(clip.xy, 1.0, 1.0);
    vec3 explosionNear = explosionNearH.xyz / max(abs(explosionNearH.w), 1e-6);
    vec3 explosionFar = explosionFarH.xyz / max(abs(explosionFarH.w), 1e-6);
    vec3 rayDir = normalize(explosionFar - explosionNear);

    float lightDist = max(length(LightPos), 1.0);
    float farT = smoothstep(35.0, 360.0, lightDist);

    vec3 toLight = LightPos / lightDist;
    float align = max(dot(rayDir, toLight), 0.0);

    // Compact flash. The old low exponents painted a very large disc even though
    // the actual light radius was correct.
    float corePow = mix(125.0, 720.0, farT);
    float bloomPow = mix(30.0, 115.0, farT);
    float washPow = mix(13.0, 44.0, farT);
    float yieldAngularScale = clamp(Radius / 90.75, 0.55, 1.85);
    float perspectiveScale = max(1.0, pow(lightDist / max(Radius * 3.0, 1.0), 1.45));
    corePow = corePow * perspectiveScale / yieldAngularScale;
    bloomPow = bloomPow * perspectiveScale / yieldAngularScale;
    washPow = washPow * perspectiveScale / yieldAngularScale;

    float sparkCore = pow(align, corePow);
    float sparkBloom = pow(align, bloomPow);
    float sparkWash = pow(align, washPow);

    float coreGain = mix(2.65, 5.1, farT);
    float bloomGain = mix(1.25, 2.3, farT);
    float washGain = mix(0.28, 0.58, farT);

    float glareMask = isSky ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    float flashDistance = 1.0 / (1.0 + pow(lightDist / max(Radius * 2.15, 1.0), 1.70));

    if (PointSource > 0.5 && FlashIntensity > 0.01
            && (isSky || length(camRel) + 0.35 >= lightDist)) {
        // Compact white glare at the actual moving part, with surface occlusion.
        bool flame = PointSource > 1.5;
        float angularSize = flame ? max(0.00045, 0.42 / max(lightDist, 1.0))
                                  : max(0.00028, 0.24 / max(lightDist, 1.0));
        float alignment = max(0.0, 1.0 - dot(rayDir, normalize(LightPos)));
        float core = exp(-alignment / (angularSize * angularSize));
        float halo = exp(-alignment / (angularSize * angularSize * 5.0));
        if(flame) {
            float outer = exp(-alignment / (angularSize * angularSize * 14.0));
            add += vec3(1.0, 0.91, 0.60) * FlashIntensity * core * 2.2;
            add += LightColor * FlashIntensity * (halo * .85 + outer * .18);
        } else add += LightColor * FlashIntensity * (core * 1.4 + halo * 0.16);
    }
    if (PointSource < 0.5 && glareMask > 0.01 && FlashIntensity > 0.01) {
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.86, 0.48) * (FlashIntensity * flashDistance * sparkCore * coreGain * 1.45 * nightGap * glareMask);
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.56, 0.12) * (FlashIntensity * flashDistance * sparkBloom * bloomGain * nightGap * glareMask);
        add += LightColor * (FlashIntensity * flashDistance * sparkWash * washGain * 0.34 * nightGap * glareMask);
        float glare = sparkCore * coreGain + sparkBloom * bloomGain;
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.66, 0.22) * (FlashIntensity * flashDistance * glare * glare * 0.16 * nightGap * glareMask);
    }

    if (SkyIntensity > 0.01) {
        // This is a finite atmospheric volume at the explosion, not a tint on
        // the infinitely distant sky.  Clamp the ray segment to the first
        // visible vanilla/DH surface, so buildings and terrain hide the volume
        // behind them while air in front of those surfaces can still glow.
        vec3 glowCenter = LightPos
                + vec3(0.0, mix(SkyRadius * 0.16, 0.0, AirBurst), 0.0);
        // SkyRadius is the soft scattering scale. Trace farther than that so
        // the Gaussian tail is effectively dark before the ray bound ends.
        float glowSigma = max(SkyRadius, 1.0);
        float glowRadius = glowSigma * 2.7;
        float centerAlongRay = dot(glowCenter, rayDir);
        float centerPerpendicularSq = max(
            dot(glowCenter, glowCenter) - centerAlongRay * centerAlongRay,
            0.0
        );
        float radiusSq = glowRadius * glowRadius;

        if (centerPerpendicularSq < radiusSq && centerAlongRay > 0.0) {
            float halfChord = sqrt(max(radiusSq - centerPerpendicularSq, 0.0));
            float segmentStart = max(centerAlongRay - halfChord, 0.0);
            float segmentEnd = centerAlongRay + halfChord;
            float surfaceDistance = isSky
                    ? 100000000.0
                    : max(dot(camRel, rayDir), 0.0);
            segmentEnd = min(segmentEnd, surfaceDistance);

            // Do not cut the sphere at glowCenter.y.  Its centre is raised for
            // a ground burst, and that old hard plane removed the whole lower
            // part of the glow, leaving a dark horizontal stripe.  Actual
            // ground/buildings already clip the volume through surfaceDistance
            // (using vanilla or DH depth), which is the physically useful mask.
            float segmentLength = max(segmentEnd - segmentStart, 0.0);
            float radial = exp(-centerPerpendicularSq / (glowSigma * glowSigma));
            float opticalDepth = 1.0 - exp(-segmentLength / max(glowSigma * 0.90, 0.001));
            float localGlow = radial * opticalDepth;
            add += LightColor * (SkyIntensity * localGlow * nightGap * mix(0.48, 0.88, farT));
            float warmCore = exp(-centerPerpendicularSq /
                    max(glowSigma * glowSigma * 0.20, 1.0));
            add += LightColor * (SkyIntensity * warmCore * opticalDepth * nightGap * 0.34);
            add += vec3(1.0, 0.85, 0.48)
                    * (SkyIntensity * localGlow * localGlow * 0.22 * nightGap);
        }
    }

    if (!isSky && Intensity > 0.01 && (!lodSurface || HasDhMatrix > 0.5)) {
        // Capsule terrain wash (prev→curr) for single-light callers
        vec3 prev = length(LightPrevPos) > 0.01 ? LightPrevPos : LightPos;
        float d = distToCapsule(camRel, prev, LightPos);
        float rad = max(Radius, 4.0);
        float finiteRange = 1.0 - smoothstep(rad * 1.10, rad * 2.15, d);
        // Preserve the exact broad, bright explosion curve from the reference
        // backup. Direction and occlusion are applied afterwards and do not
        // change its radius, colour or centre brightness.
        float atten = (1.0 / (1.0 + (d / rad) * (d / rad))) * finiteRange;
        if (PointSource > 0.5) atten = pow(max(0.0, 1.0-d/rad), 2.0);
        vec3 surfaceNormal = normalize(cross(dFdx(camRel), dFdy(camRel)));
        if (dot(surfaceNormal, -rayDir) < 0.0) surfaceNormal = -surfaceNormal;
        // A ground detonation is a large rising fireball, not a point lamp 0.6
        // blocks above the soil. Aim surface lighting/shadow rays at the centre
        // of that volume so horizontal ground receives the reference brightness.
        vec3 effectiveLightPos = LightPos
                + vec3(0.0, mix(rad * 0.24, 0.0, AirBurst), 0.0);
        if(PointSource > 0.5) effectiveLightPos = LightPos + vec3(0.0, 0.10, 0.0);
        vec3 towardLight = normalize(effectiveLightPos - camRel);
        // Binary-soft visibility of a side, rather than Lambert dimming. A side
        // that can see the large flash keeps the backup's full light intensity.
        float facing = smoothstep(-0.045, 0.14, dot(surfaceNormal, towardLight));
        if(PointSource > 0.5) facing = max(0.0, dot(surfaceNormal, towardLight));
        float visibility = 0.0;
        // Shadow tracing is the expensive part. Do it only where the finite
        // explosion light can contribute a visible amount.
        if (atten > 0.002 && facing > 0.001) {
            visibility = explosionVisibility(camRel + surfaceNormal * 0.35, effectiveLightPos);
        }
        float lit = Intensity * atten * nightGap * facing * visibility;
        add += LightColor * lit;
        if(PointSource < 0.5) {
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.97, 0.88) * (lit * atten * atten * 0.50);

        // Original large hot centre from the backup, now only masked by the
        // receiving side and line-of-sight to the blast.
        float hotRadius = max(rad * 0.30, 5.0);
        float hot = 1.0 / (1.0 + (d / hotRadius) * (d / hotRadius));
        hot *= hot * finiteRange;
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.82, 0.42)
                * (Intensity * hot * nightGap * facing * visibility * 1.35);
        add += vec3(1.0, 0.48, 0.10)
                * (Intensity * atten * nightGap * facing * visibility * 0.34);

        // Very weak indirect orange bounce for back-facing walls. This is not
        // direct light through the building; it prevents the unlit side from
        // becoming a pasted-on black cutout against the blazing ground.
        float bounce = (1.0 - facing) * Intensity * atten * nightGap * 0.075;
        add += vec3(0.82, 0.32, 0.055) * bounce;
        }
    }

    fragColor = vec4(scene.rgb + add, scene.a);
}

#version 150

in vec2 texCoord;
in vec4 vertexColor;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
    vec2 p = texCoord * 2.0 - 1.0;
    float r = length(p);
    // Soft thermal stamp — max-blend into heat mask
    float soft = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.15, 1.0, r);
    soft *= soft;
    float t = vertexColor.r * soft;
    if (t < 0.004) {
        discard;
    }
    fragColor = vec4(t, t, t, 1.0);
}

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/mavic_quality.fsh

#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}
uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;
uniform sampler2D SceneDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform mat4 SceneInverse;
uniform mat4 DhInverse;
uniform vec2 OutSize;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform float ZoomFactor;
uniform float Time;
in vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 fragColor;
float rangeAt(float depth,mat4 inverse,bool distant){
    if(distant ? !cmDhSurface(depth) : depth>=0.9999995)return 1e6;
    vec4 p=inverse*vec4(texCoord*2.0-1.0,depth*2.0-1.0,1.0);
    return length(p.xyz/max(abs(p.w),1e-7));
}
float hash(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}
void main(){
    float distance=rangeAt(texture(SceneDepthSampler,texCoord).r,SceneInverse,false);
    if(HasDhDepth>.5)distance=min(distance,rangeAt(texture(DhDepthSampler,texCoord).r,DhInverse,true));
    float farDetail=distance>99999.0?0.0:smoothstep(180.0,600.0,distance);
    float qualityLoss=clamp(ZoomFactor*(.08+.92*farDetail),0.0,1.0);
    // Continuous optical point-spread, atmospheric contrast loss and sensor grain.
    // No quantized UV grid: detail fades smoothly instead of turning into mosaic tiles.
    vec2 radius=(.2+3.8*qualityLoss)/OutSize;
    vec3 color=vec3(0.0);
    for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){
        float weight=(i==0?2.0:1.0)*(j==0?2.0:1.0)/16.0;
        color+=texture(DiffuseSampler,texCoord+vec2(i,j)*radius).rgb*weight;
    }
    float luminance=dot(color,vec3(.299,.587,.114));
    color=mix(color,vec3(luminance),qualityLoss*.12);
    color=mix(color,vec3(.48),qualityLoss*.10);
    float noise=(hash(floor(texCoord*OutSize)+floor(Time*18.0))-.5)*qualityLoss*.018;
    fragColor=vec4(clamp(color+noise,0.0,1.0),1.0);
}

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/optics_flir.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}

// Phase-1 WH FLIR — MUST match FlirHeatCodec.java
//
// CRITICAL: Minecraft smoke sprites are DARK. Vertex color (1,0.04,0.02) * tex≈0.3
// yields RGB≈(0.3,0.01,0.006). Absolute R>0.88 NEVER fires. Detect by RATIOS only.
// Temperature from G/R (texture-invariant). Display white from temp, NEVER from scene luma.

uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;
uniform sampler2D HeatSampler;
uniform sampler2D SceneDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform vec2 OutSize;
uniform float Time;
uniform float Thermal;
uniform float Degrade;
uniform float NoiseAmount;
uniform float HeatBoost;
uniform float Flash;
uniform float Exposure;
uniform vec2 FlashUv;
uniform float FlashRad;
uniform float MissileOnly;
uniform float ThermalMode;
uniform float HasHeatMask;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform vec3 SkyColor;
uniform float ThermalLow;
uniform float ThermalHigh;
uniform float EnvironmentLow;
uniform float EnvironmentHigh;
uniform float LaunchSaturation;

in vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 fragColor;

float impulseSpread(vec2 uv, float lod) {
    vec2 stepSize=exp2(lod)/vec2(textureSize(HeatSampler,0));
    // Rotationally distributed overlapping taps: avoid the old 3x3 grid ghost.
    float result=textureLod(HeatSampler,uv,lod-.5).g*.28;
    for(int i=0;i<12;i++) {
        float angle=float(i)*2.39996323;
        float radius=sqrt((float(i)+.5)/12.0)*1.55;
        result+=textureLod(HeatSampler,uv+vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle))*stepSize*radius,lod-.5).g*.06;
    }
    return result;
}

float hash(vec2 p) {
    return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453123);
}

float luma(vec3 c) {
    return dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
}

float sampleLuma(vec2 uv) {
    return luma(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv).rgb);
}

float opticsEdge(vec2 uv) {
    vec2 px = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
    float l = sampleLuma(uv - vec2(px.x, 0.0));
    float r = sampleLuma(uv + vec2(px.x, 0.0));
    float d = sampleLuma(uv - vec2(0.0, px.y));
    float u = sampleLuma(uv + vec2(0.0, px.y));
    float gx = r - l;
    float gy = u - d;
    return sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
}

vec3 sampleSoft(vec2 uv, float radiusPx) {
    vec2 texel = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
    if (radiusPx < 0.2) {
        return texture(DiffuseSampler, uv).rgb;
    }
    vec2 r = texel * radiusPx;
    vec3 a = texture(DiffuseSampler, uv).rgb * 0.40;
    a += texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(r.x, 0.0)).rgb * 0.15;
    a += texture(DiffuseSampler, uv - vec2(r.x, 0.0)).rgb * 0.15;
    a += texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(0.0, r.y)).rgb * 0.15;
    a += texture(DiffuseSampler, uv - vec2(0.0, r.y)).rgb * 0.15;
    return a;
}

// Ratio marker: works on dark smoke tex. Wood fails (G≈R).
float markerPresence(vec3 c) {
    float r = max(c.r, 0.001);
    float gOverR = c.g / r;
    float bOverR = c.b / r;
    float redFrac = (c.r - c.g) / r;
    if (c.r < 0.008) return 0.0; // dark debris sprites after vertex×tex
    if (c.g > c.r + 0.01) return 0.0; // grass
    // Wood/dirt: G rides with R (oak~0.75, acacia~0.53)
    if (gOverR > 0.40) return 0.0;
    if (bOverR > 0.45) return 0.0;
    if (redFrac < 0.55) return 0.0;
    return clamp((redFrac - 0.50) * 3.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}

// Hot tint G/R≈0.02 → temp1; cool G/R≈0.34 → temp0. Scale-invariant.
float markerTemp(vec3 c) {
    float gOverR = c.g / max(c.r, 0.001);
    return clamp(1.0 - (gOverR - 0.02) / 0.32, 0.0, 1.0);
}

float markerPresenceMax(vec2 uv, float px) {
    vec2 t = (1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0))) * px;
    float m = markerPresence(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv).rgb);
    m = max(m, markerPresence(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(t.x, 0.0)).rgb));
    m = max(m, markerPresence(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv - vec2(t.x, 0.0)).rgb));
    m = max(m, markerPresence(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(0.0, t.y)).rgb));
    m = max(m, markerPresence(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv - vec2(0.0, t.y)).rgb));
    return m;
}

void main() {
    vec2 uv = texCoord;
    if (Thermal > 0.5 && HasHeatMask > 0.5) {
        // HDR radiance is composed before detector/display processing.
        vec2 px = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
        float signal = texture(HeatSampler, uv).r;
        float surround = 0.0;
        for (int j=-1;j<=1;j++) for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++)
            surround += texture(HeatSampler, uv+vec2(i,j)*px).r;
        float sensed = signal*.88 + surround*(.12/9.0);
        // Three optical-scatter scales, driven by the impulse's HDR energy.
        // Ordinary hot smoke and fragments cannot create a persistent fog halo.
        float nearGlare=impulseSpread(uv,2.0);
        float middleGlare=impulseSpread(uv,4.0);
        float wideGlare=impulseSpread(uv,6.0);
        sensed+=nearGlare*.26+middleGlare*.38+wideGlare*.22;
        float level = log(1.0+max(sensed,0.0));
        float span = max(ThermalHigh-ThermalLow,0.3);
        float x = max(0.0,(level-ThermalLow)/span);
        // Shoulder retains gradients in hot clouds instead of clipping every
        // sample above a fixed temperature to the same white value.
        float g = 1.0-exp(-x*1.35);
        float signalLevel=log(1.+max(signal,0.));
        float environmentX=max(0.,(signalLevel-EnvironmentLow)/max(.18,EnvironmentHigh-EnvironmentLow));
        float environmentGray=1.-exp(-environmentX*.90);
        // Existing explosion exposure/impulse response is preserved in heated pixels.
        float protectedHeat=texture(HeatSampler,uv).a;
        float bareX=max(0.,(signalLevel-ThermalLow)/span);
        float glareDelta=g-(1.-exp(-bareX*1.35));
        g=mix(environmentGray+glareDelta,g,smoothstep(0.,.10,protectedHeat));
        // Vehicle pixels carry a negative identification channel. A wider detector
        // window preserves gradients in warm running gear without altering explosions.
        float vehicleMask=smoothstep(.20,.75,-texture(HeatSampler,uv).b)*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.10,protectedHeat));
        float vehicleX=max(0.,(signalLevel-EnvironmentLow)/max(.16,EnvironmentHigh-EnvironmentLow));
        float vehicleGray=1.-exp(-vehicleX*.90);
        g=mix(g,vehicleGray+glareDelta,vehicleMask);
        float detail = log(1.0+max(signal,0.0))-log(1.0+max(surround/9.0,0.0));
        // Mild local contrast overshoot gives the opposite-polarity contour.
        // It is display processing, not a cold physical ring around the blast.
        float localMean=0.0;
        vec2 detectorPx=1.0/vec2(textureSize(HeatSampler,0));
        for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++)
            localMean+=textureLod(HeatSampler,uv+vec2(i,j)*detectorPx*5.0,0.0).r/9.0;
        float edge=log(1.0+max(signal,0.0))-log(1.0+max(localMean,0.0));
        g+=clamp(edge/span,-.16,.12)*.48;
        // A saturated source loses internal detail and expands via optical scatter.
        // Invert only at the end, so BLACK HOT glare remains dark.
        float overload=smoothstep(2.2,4.2,x);
        g=mix(g,1.0,overload*.96);
        // Local body contrast enhancement, with source visibility/absorption preserved.
        // Does not tint terrain or expose entities hidden by walls or dense smoke.
        float body=texture(HeatSampler,uv).b;
        g=max(g,.82*body);
        g += (hash(uv*OutSize+vec2(Time*17.0))-0.5)*NoiseAmount*.06;
        g = clamp(g,0.01,0.995);
        g = mix(g,1.0,clamp(LaunchSaturation,0.0,1.0));
        if(ThermalMode>0.5)g=1.0-g;
        fragColor=vec4(vec3(g),1.0);
        return;
    }
    if (Thermal < -0.5) {
        vec4 tv = texture(DiffuseSampler, uv);
        float sceneDepth = texture(SceneDepthSampler, uv).r;
        float dhDepth = HasDhDepth > 0.5 ? texture(DhDepthSampler, uv).r : 1.0;
        float emptySky = step(0.9999995, sceneDepth) * (HasDhDepth>.5 && cmDhSurface(dhDepth)?0.:1.);
        float blackSky = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.10, luma(tv.rgb));
        float missingSky = emptySky * max(1.0 - step(0.1, tv.a), blackSky);
        fragColor = vec4(mix(tv.rgb, SkyColor, missingSky), 1.0);
        return;
    }
    float d = clamp(Degrade, 0.0, 1.0);
    bool missileOnly = MissileOnly > 0.5;
    bool thermal = Thermal > 0.5;
    bool blackHot = ThermalMode > 0.5;

    vec4 raw = texture(DiffuseSampler, uv);
    if (thermal) {
        // Preserve real hot geometry inside this output pixel's source footprint.
        // This is heat-aware reduction, not a screen-space target marker or halo.
        ivec2 sourceSize = textureSize(DiffuseSampler, 0);
        float bestHeat = -1.0;
        vec4 strongest = raw;
        for (int iy = 0; iy < 2; ++iy) {
            for (int ix = 0; ix < 2; ++ix) {
                vec2 offset = (vec2(ix, iy) - vec2(0.5)) * 0.5 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
                ivec2 pixel = clamp(ivec2((uv + offset) * vec2(sourceSize)), ivec2(0), sourceSize - 1);
                vec4 candidate = texelFetch(DiffuseSampler, pixel, 0);
                float strength = markerPresence(candidate.rgb);
                if (strength > bestHeat) {
                    bestHeat = strength;
                    strongest = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        if (bestHeat > 0.2) raw = strongest;
    }
    // Minimal blur in thermal — chroma is fragile
    float blurPx = thermal ? mix(0.15, 0.45, d) : mix(0.35, 1.4, d * d);
    vec3 scene = sampleSoft(uv, blurPx);
    if (raw.a < 0.15) {
        scene = sampleSoft(uv, 2.5);
    }
    float y = clamp(luma(scene), 0.0, 1.0);
    float rawY = clamp(luma(raw.rgb), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 outc;

    if (thermal) {
        // Ambient radiance proxy: modest material/illumination variation, never
        // classify whole block types as white-hot. Depth separates sky from land.
        float depth = texture(SceneDepthSampler, uv).r;
        float dhDepth = HasDhDepth > 0.5 ? texture(DhDepthSampler, uv).r : 1.0;
        float sky = step(0.9999995, depth) * (HasDhDepth>.5 && cmDhSurface(dhDepth)?0.:1.);
        float vegetation = clamp(scene.g - 0.5 * (scene.r + scene.b), 0.0, 0.4);
        float water = clamp(scene.b - max(scene.r, scene.g), 0.0, 0.4);
        // Keep ordinary terrain below the palette midpoint: 50% gray barely
        // changes under inversion and made WH/BH terrain look identical.
        float ambient = 0.23 + 0.23 * sqrt(y) - vegetation * 0.09 - water * 0.12;
        float surfaceDetail = y - luma(sampleSoft(uv, 2.0));
        ambient = clamp(ambient + surfaceDetail * 0.18, 0.20, 0.46);
        ambient = mix(ambient, 0.13 + 0.045 * y, sky);

        float presence = markerPresence(raw.rgb);
        float heatWeight = smoothstep(0.05, 0.28, presence);
        float temperature = markerTemp(raw.rgb);
        // Sprite luminance contributes fine structure, not the absolute heat:
        // dark smoke textures must still represent a hot expanding gas cloud.
        float detail = smoothstep(0.015, 0.65, raw.r);
        float radiance = 0.38 + 0.58 * pow(temperature, 0.72);
        radiance += (detail - 0.5) * 0.12 * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.9, 0.99, temperature));
        float saturated = smoothstep(0.91, 0.985, temperature) * heatWeight;
        float g = mix(ambient, radiance, heatWeight);
        g = mix(g, 1.0, saturated);

        // Optical spread is derived ONLY from visible hot pixels. No projected
        // flash disk, so it cannot detach from the explosion or pass terrain.
        vec2 pixelSize = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
        float spread = 0.0;
        for (int iy = -1; iy <= 1; ++iy) {
            for (int ix = -1; ix <= 1; ++ix) {
                vec3 neighbor = texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(ix, iy) * pixelSize).rgb;
                spread += markerPresence(neighbor) * smoothstep(0.92, 0.995, markerTemp(neighbor));
            }
        }
        g += (1.0 - g) * spread / 9.0 * 0.32;
        // Weak wider PSF wing around saturated sources; never a projected disk.
        float wing = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            float angle = float(i) * 0.785398;
            vec3 neighbor = texture(DiffuseSampler, uv + vec2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * pixelSize * 3.0).rgb;
            wing += markerPresence(neighbor) * smoothstep(0.96, 0.995, markerTemp(neighbor));
        }
        g += (1.0 - g) * wing * 0.012;
        float grain = hash(uv * OutSize + vec2(Time * 29.0, Time * 17.0)) - 0.5;
        g += grain * NoiseAmount * 0.12 * (1.0 - saturated);
        g = clamp(g, 0.02, 1.0);
        // Apply palette last: identical radiance response for both polarities.
        g = mix(g,1.0,clamp(LaunchSaturation,0.0,1.0));
        if (blackHot) g = 1.0 - g;
        fragColor = vec4(vec3(g), 1.0);
        return;
    }
    if (missileOnly) {
        float g = mix(0.55, 0.95, smoothstep(0.02, 0.9, rawY));
        float a = clamp(max(raw.a, smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, rawY)), 0.0, 1.0);
        if (a < 0.02) {
            fragColor = vec4(0.0);
            return;
        }
        fragColor = vec4(vec3(g), a);
        return;
    }

    float softY = luma(sampleSoft(uv, 1.05));
    float widerY = luma(sampleSoft(uv, 2.15));
    float detail = rawY - widerY;
    float spike = max(rawY - softY, 0.0);
    float edge = opticsEdge(uv);
    float g = rawY + detail * 1.65 + edge * 0.30;
    g = mix(g, g - spike * 0.55, 0.35);
    g = (g - 0.5) * mix(1.18, 0.92, d) + 0.5;
    outc = mix(vec3(clamp(g, 0.0, 1.0)), vec3(0.78), d * 0.22);
    float scan = 0.988 + 0.012 * sin(uv.y * OutSize.y * 2.8 + Time * 6.0);
    outc *= scan;
    float n1 = hash(uv * OutSize + vec2(Time * 37.0, Time * 19.0));
    outc += vec3((n1 - 0.5) * NoiseAmount * 0.35);
    fragColor = vec4(clamp(outc, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
}

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/sam_smoke_light.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform vec3 Emitter;
uniform vec3 Jet;
uniform float Energy;
uniform float LightRadius;
in vec2 texCoord;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec3 worldPos;
out vec4 fragColor;
void main() {
    vec4 tex = texture(Sampler0, texCoord);
    float opacity = tex.a * vertexColor.a;
    if (opacity < 0.001) discard;
    float t = clamp(dot(worldPos - Emitter, Jet) / max(dot(Jet, Jet), 0.0001), 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 delta = Emitter + Jet * t - worldPos;
    float distance = length(delta);
    float attenuation = 1.0 / pow(1.0 + distance * distance / (LightRadius * LightRadius), 2.0);
    // Texture relief gives each puff a lit side and a shaded side. Derivatives
    // are in screen space, so the reconstructed tangent frame rotates with it.
    float density = dot(tex.rgb, vec3(0.3333)) * tex.a;
    vec3 dx = dFdx(worldPos), dy = dFdy(worldPos);
    vec3 facing = normalize(-worldPos);
    vec3 normal = normalize(facing - normalize(dx + vec3(1e-8)) * dFdx(density) * 18.0
                                   - normalize(dy + vec3(1e-8)) * dFdy(density) * 18.0);
    vec3 toLight = delta / max(distance, 0.001);
    float diffuse = max(dot(normal, toLight), 0.0);
    float transmission = pow(max(dot(-facing, toLight), 0.0), 3.0) * (1.0 - tex.a * 0.65);
    float relief = 0.16 + diffuse * 0.64 + transmission * 0.20;
    vec3 color = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.59, 0.27), vec3(1.0, 0.87, 0.66), attenuation);
    fragColor = vec4(color * Energy * attenuation * opacity * relief * 0.14, 0.0);
}

#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}

uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform mat4 DhInvViewProjMat;
uniform vec2 ScreenSize;
uniform float HasDhDepth;

in vec2 texCoord;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec3 cameraRelativePos;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
    vec4 smoke = texture(Sampler0, texCoord) * vertexColor;
    // Remove the nearly transparent rectangular outskirts of large atlas
    // sprites; they otherwise read as holes over denser smoke behind them.
    if (smoke.a < 0.035) discard;
    if (HasDhDepth > 0.5) {
        vec2 screenUv = gl_FragCoord.xy / max(ScreenSize, vec2(1.0));
        float dhDepth = texture(DhDepthSampler, screenUv).r;
        if (cmDhSurface(dhDepth)) {
            vec4 clip = vec4(screenUv * 2.0 - 1.0, dhDepth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
            vec4 dhH = DhInvViewProjMat * clip;
            vec3 dhPos = dhH.xyz / max(abs(dhH.w), 1e-6);
            float particleDistance = length(cameraRelativePos);
            float tolerance = clamp(1.0 + particleDistance * 0.0025, 1.0, 6.0);
            if (length(dhPos) + tolerance < particleDistance) discard;
        }
    }
    fragColor = smoke;
}

in vec3 Position;
in vec2 UV0;
in vec4 Color;

uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;

out vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 vertexColor;
out vec3 cameraRelativePos;

    texCoord = UV0;
    vertexColor = Color;
    cameraRelativePos = Position;

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/smoke_glow.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}

uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform mat4 DhInvViewProjMat;
uniform vec2 ScreenSize;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform vec3 GlowColor;
uniform float GlowStrength;
uniform vec3 LightPos;
uniform float NightFactor;

in vec2 texCoord;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec3 worldPos;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
    vec4 smoke = texture(Sampler0, texCoord);
    float alpha = smoke.a * vertexColor.a;
    if (alpha < 0.01) {
        discard;
    }
    // Match the ordinary smoke pass: illuminated particles behind DH terrain
    // must not show through while their unlit silhouettes are occluded.
    if (HasDhDepth > 0.5) {
        vec2 screenUv = gl_FragCoord.xy / max(ScreenSize, vec2(1.0));
        float dhDepth = texture(DhDepthSampler, screenUv).r;
        if (cmDhSurface(dhDepth)) {
            vec4 clip = vec4(screenUv * 2.0 - 1.0, dhDepth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
            vec4 dhH = DhInvViewProjMat * clip;
            vec3 dhPos = dhH.xyz / max(abs(dhH.w), 1e-6);
            float particleDistance = length(worldPos);
            float tolerance = clamp(1.0 + particleDistance * 0.0025, 1.0, 6.0);
            if (length(dhPos) + tolerance < particleDistance) discard;
        }
    }

    float texLuma = dot(smoke.rgb, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    float detail = 0.45 + texLuma * 0.55;

    // Reconstruct a soft relief normal from the actual smoke silhouette. This makes
    // one side of every lobe receive the world-space explosion light instead of
    // uniformly recolouring the whole billboard.
    vec2 texel = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(Sampler0, 0));
    float ax0 = texture(Sampler0, texCoord - vec2(texel.x, 0.0)).a;
    float ax1 = texture(Sampler0, texCoord + vec2(texel.x, 0.0)).a;
    float ay0 = texture(Sampler0, texCoord - vec2(0.0, texel.y)).a;
    float ay1 = texture(Sampler0, texCoord + vec2(0.0, texel.y)).a;
    vec2 relief = vec2(ax0 - ax1, ay0 - ay1);

    vec3 tangent = normalize(dFdx(worldPos));
    vec3 bitangent = normalize(dFdy(worldPos));
    vec3 facing = normalize(-worldPos);
    vec3 normal = normalize(facing + tangent * relief.x * 3.2 + bitangent * relief.y * 3.2);
    vec3 toLight = normalize(LightPos - worldPos);
    float diffuse = max(dot(normal, toLight), 0.0);
    float isotropic = 0.72 + 0.28 * abs(dot(normal, toLight));
    float rim = pow(1.0 - abs(dot(normal, facing)), 2.0);
    // Smoke is a participating volume, not an opaque billboard surface. Keep a
    // strong isotropic term so rotating the camera cannot switch its light off;
    // relief/diffuse only shapes the lobes on top of that stable illumination.
    float volumeLight = isotropic * 0.70 + diffuse * 0.48 + rim * 0.10;
    float lighting = mix(detail, detail * volumeLight, clamp(NightFactor, 0.0, 1.0));

    vec3 glow = GlowColor * vertexColor.rgb * (GlowStrength * alpha * lighting);
    fragColor = vec4(glow, alpha);
}

#version 150
uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
in vec4 thermalColor;
in vec2 texCoord;
in float facing;
out vec4 fragColor;
float roughness(vec2 uv){return dot(texture(Sampler0,uv).rgb,vec3(.299,.587,.114));}
void main(){
 if(thermalColor.a<.1)discard;
 vec4 sample=texture(Sampler0,texCoord);if(sample.a<.1)discard;
 vec2 px=1./vec2(textureSize(Sampler0,0));
 float mean=(roughness(texCoord+vec2(px.x*2.,0))+roughness(texCoord-vec2(px.x*2.,0))+roughness(texCoord+vec2(0,px.y*2.))+roughness(texCoord-vec2(0,px.y*2.)))*.25;
 // Base temperature still comes only from components. Texture high-pass supplies
 // microstructure; viewing angle models a weak emissivity/reflection change.
 float variation=(facing-.5)*5.+clamp(roughness(texCoord)-mean,-.5,.5)*5.;
 float t=240.+thermalColor.g/max(thermalColor.r,.001)*600.+variation;
 float code=clamp((t-200.)/1200.,0.,1.)*32767.;
 fragColor=vec4((128.+floor(code/256.))/255.,mod(code,256.)/255.,thermalColor.b,thermalColor.a);
}

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/thermal_particle.fsh

#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}
uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D SceneDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform mat4 SceneInverse;
uniform mat4 DhInverse;
uniform vec2 ScreenSize;
uniform vec3 CameraOrigin;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform float Time;
in vec2 texCoord;
in vec2 particleCoord;
in vec2 thermalMeta;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec3 cameraRelativePos;
out vec4 fragColor;
// Keep custom helpers distinct from GLSL's built-in vec3 noise3(genType).
float cmThermalValueNoise3(vec3 p){
 vec3 i=floor(p),f=fract(p); f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
 vec4 n=vec4(dot(i,vec3(1,57,113)))+vec4(0,1,57,58);
 vec4 a=fract(sin(n)*43758.5453),b=fract(sin(n+113.)*43758.5453);
 vec4 c=mix(a,b,f.z); return mix(mix(c.x,c.y,f.x),mix(c.z,c.w,f.x),f.y);
}
float radiance(float kelvin){return 120.0/(exp(1438.8/max(kelvin,150.))-1.0);}
bool blocked(float depth,mat4 inverse,vec2 uv,bool distant){
 if(distant ? !cmDhSurface(depth) : depth>=0.9999995)return false;
 vec4 h=inverse*vec4(uv*2.-1.,depth*2.-1.,1);
 float distance=length(h.xyz/h.w);
 bool nozzle=abs(thermalMeta.y-30002.)<.5;
 float tolerance=nozzle?clamp(length(cameraRelativePos)*.00002,.05,.4):clamp(length(cameraRelativePos)*.001,.5,8.);
 return distance+tolerance<length(cameraRelativePos);
}
// Reconstruct the particle atlas continuously even when Minecraft uses nearest
// filtering for pixel-art textures. This prevents blocky gas/flash silhouettes.
vec4 smoothSprite(vec2 uv){
 ivec2 size=textureSize(Sampler0,0);
 vec2 pixel=uv*vec2(size)-.5;
 ivec2 base=ivec2(floor(pixel));vec2 f=fract(pixel);
 vec4 a=texelFetch(Sampler0,clamp(base,ivec2(0),size-1),0);
 vec4 b=texelFetch(Sampler0,clamp(base+ivec2(1,0),ivec2(0),size-1),0);
 vec4 c=texelFetch(Sampler0,clamp(base+ivec2(0,1),ivec2(0),size-1),0);
 vec4 d=texelFetch(Sampler0,clamp(base+ivec2(1),ivec2(0),size-1),0);
 return mix(mix(a,b,f.x),mix(c,d,f.x),f.y);
}
float nozzleProfile(vec2 p){
 float r=length(p);
 return exp(-r*r*5.)*(1.-smoothstep(.65,1.,r));
}
void main(){
 vec2 screen=gl_FragCoord.xy/ScreenSize;
 if(blocked(texture(SceneDepthSampler,screen).r,SceneInverse,screen,false))discard;
 if(HasDhDepth>.5 && blocked(texture(DhDepthSampler,screen).r,DhInverse,screen,true))discard;
 bool nozzle=abs(thermalMeta.y-30002.)<.5;
 vec4 s;
 if(nozzle){
  vec2 p=particleCoord*2.-1.;
  vec2 footprint=fwidth(p)*.25;
  // Integrate the smooth source over the pixel, especially at distant/subpixel sizes.
  float alpha=(nozzleProfile(p+footprint)+nozzleProfile(p-footprint)
       +nozzleProfile(p+vec2(footprint.x,-footprint.y))
       +nozzleProfile(p+vec2(-footprint.x,footprint.y)))*.25;
  s=vec4(1.,1.,1.,alpha);
 }else s=smoothSprite(texCoord);
 float heat=clamp(1.-(vertexColor.g/max(vertexColor.r,.001)-.02)/.32,0.,1.);
 float density=dot(s.rgb,vec3(.299,.587,.114));
 // World anchored turbulence modulates gas temperature and optical thickness.
 // Opaque incandescent shards retain their real sprite silhouette.
 // Blue is a material tag in this dedicated pass, never a visible tint.
 float solid=1.-step(.4,vertexColor.b);
 // Gas tag .5..1 carries the short initial energy pulse independently of
 // cooling temperature. It cannot turn the entire cloud into one clipped value.
 bool groundGas=solid<.5 && vertexColor.b<.49;
 float pulse=solid>.5 ? 0. : (groundGas ? clamp((vertexColor.b-.40)/.08,0.,1.) : clamp((vertexColor.b-.5)*2.,0.,1.));
 if(thermalMeta.y>29999.5 && thermalMeta.y<30001.5){
  solid=0.;groundGas=thermalMeta.y>30000.5;
  pulse=clamp(thermalMeta.x/32767.,0.,1.);
 }
 vec3 world=cameraRelativePos+CameraOrigin;
 float emission=0.;
 float impulseEmission=0.;
 float transmission=1.;
 if(solid>.5){
  transmission=exp(-s.a*vertexColor.a*7.);
  emission=radiance(nozzle ? clamp(thermalMeta.x,300.,3800.) : 293.+heat*heat*1350.)*(1.-transmission);
  impulseEmission=emission*(nozzle?4.5:pow(heat,6.)*1.4);
 }else{
  // Integrate five emitting/absorbing layers through a turbulent gas slab.
  // The sprite bounds the plume; temperature and density vary within it.
  vec3 ray=normalize(cameraRelativePos+vec3(0,0,.0001));
  for(int layer=0;layer<5;layer++){
   vec3 point=world+ray*(float(layer)-2.)*1.6;
   vec3 stablePoint=vec3(particleCoord*3.7,float(layer)*.4);
   float eddy=.72*cmThermalValueNoise3(stablePoint)+.28*cmThermalValueNoise3(stablePoint*2.1); // Smooth, spatially coherent structure, no rapid texture shimmer.
   float filament=smoothstep(.22,.78,eddy);
   // Hot ground gas radiates independently of the short optical impulse.
   // Preserve turbulent detail while avoiding an artificially cold mean cloud.
   float localHeat=heat*(groundGas ? .46+.14*density+.40*filament : .40+.15*density+.45*filament);
   float baseKelvin=293.+localHeat*localHeat*2200.;
   float kelvin=baseKelvin+pulse*(4800.+10500.*filament);
   float opticalDepth=s.a*vertexColor.a*(.15+.85*density)*(.20+filament)*.42;
   float absorption=1.-exp(-opticalDepth);
   emission+=transmission*absorption*radiance(kelvin);
   impulseEmission+=transmission*absorption*(max(0.,radiance(kelvin)-radiance(baseKelvin))+radiance(baseKelvin)*pow(heat,4.)*.16);
   transmission*=1.-absorption;
  }
 }
 float opacity=1.-transmission;
 if(opacity<(nozzle ? .000001 : .002))discard;
 // Radiance remains HDR; alpha is absorption, independent of temperature.
 float opticalDepth=-log(max(transmission,.00001));
 fragColor=vec4(emission/max(opacity,.00001)*opticalDepth,
                impulseEmission/max(opacity,.00001)*opticalDepth,0.,opticalDepth);
}

================================================
File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/thermal_resolve.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}
uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;
uniform sampler2D HeatSampler;
uniform sampler2D SceneDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform float HasDhDepth;
uniform float LodKelvin;
uniform vec2 OutSize;
uniform mat4 SceneInverse;
uniform mat4 DhInverse;
uniform int SurfaceCount;
uniform float SurfaceCenters[32];
uniform float SurfaceHeat[8];
uniform float SurfaceAxes[32];
uniform int VehicleCount;
uniform float VehicleCenters[128];
uniform float VehicleAxes[128];
uniform float VehicleRotations[128];
uniform float VehicleSensors[128];
uniform sampler2D VehicleFieldSampler;
in vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 fragColor;
float rad(float t){return 120./(exp(1438.8/t)-1.);}
float terrainNoise(vec2 p){
 vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
 float a=fract(sin(dot(i,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);
 float b=fract(sin(dot(i+vec2(1,0),vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);
 float c=fract(sin(dot(i+vec2(0,1),vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);
 float d=fract(sin(dot(i+vec2(1),vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);
 return mix(mix(a,b,f.x),mix(c,d,f.x),f.y);
}
void main(){
 vec2 uv=texCoord;
 float sky=step(.9999995,texture(SceneDepthSampler,uv).r);
 if(HasDhDepth>.5)sky*=cmDhSurface(texture(DhDepthSampler,uv).r)?0.:1.;
 // Reconstruct the visible surface, never paint a projected heat circle over the sky.
 float depth=texture(SceneDepthSampler,uv).r;
 vec4 point=SceneInverse*vec4(uv*2.-1.,depth*2.-1.,1.);
 if(depth>=.9999995 && HasDhDepth>.5){depth=texture(DhDepthSampler,uv).r;point=DhInverse*vec4(uv*2.-1.,depth*2.-1.,1.);}
 vec3 position=point.xyz/max(abs(point.w),.000001);
 // Exact raster material marker, read without interpolating identities across silhouettes.
 vec3 surfacePixel=texelFetch(DiffuseSampler,clamp(ivec2(uv*vec2(textureSize(DiffuseSampler,0))),ivec2(0),textureSize(DiffuseSampler,0)-1),0).rgb;
 bool terrain=surfacePixel.r>=.5 && abs(surfacePixel.b-82./255.)<.002;
 float t=sky>.5?248.:(terrain?200.+((surfacePixel.r*255.-128.)*256.+surfacePixel.g*255.)/32767.*1200.:LodKelvin);
 float emissivity=.96;
 float warmed=0.;
 for(int k=0;k<8;k++)if(k<SurfaceCount && sky<.5){
  vec3 delta=position-vec3(SurfaceCenters[k*4],SurfaceCenters[k*4+1],SurfaceCenters[k*4+2]);
  float radius=SurfaceCenters[k*4+3];
  // Impact-relative multi-scale structure remains fixed as the camera moves.
  vec2 q=delta.xz/max(radius,1.);
  vec2 warp=vec2(terrainNoise(q*4.1+3.7),terrainNoise(q*4.1+19.3))-.5;
  vec2 distorted=q+warp*.45;
  vec2 axis=vec2(SurfaceAxes[k*4],SurfaceAxes[k*4+1]);
  float along=dot(distorted,axis)/max(1.,SurfaceAxes[k*4+2]);
  float across=dot(distorted,vec2(-axis.y,axis.x));
  float r2=along*along+across*across;
  float textureHeat=.40+.36*terrainNoise(q*7.7)+.24*terrainNoise(q*18.3);
  float skirt=exp(-r2/ .32)*textureHeat;
  float core=exp(-dot(q,q)/.032);
  float footprint=skirt*.50+core*1.10;
  float contact=1.-smoothstep(2.,max(7.,radius*.55),abs(delta.y));
  // Heat follows continuous world distance, not individual cube face orientation.
  float facing=1.;
  warmed=max(warmed,SurfaceHeat[k]*footprint*contact*facing);
 }
 t+=warmed;
 float background=emissivity*rad(t)+(1.-emissivity)*rad(t-5.);
 // Real missile models still supply the existing heat attribute in scene RGB.
 // Fetch source pixels before reduction so distant silhouettes are retained.
 float body=0.;float vehicleGlare=0.;float entityRadiance=0.;bool entityFound=false;bool vehicleFound=false;
 ivec2 size=textureSize(DiffuseSampler,0);
  // Examine the native source footprint before reducing radiance: small targets cannot
 // vanish merely because their skin fell between four downsample taps (up to 4K input).
 ivec2 outputPixel=ivec2(floor(uv*OutSize));
 ivec2 first=ivec2(floor(vec2(outputPixel)*vec2(size)/OutSize));
 ivec2 last=ivec2(ceil(vec2(outputPixel+1)*vec2(size)/OutSize));
 ivec2 span=min(ivec2(6),max(ivec2(1),last-first));
 for(int j=0;j<6;j++)for(int i=0;i<6;i++)if(i<span.x && j<span.y){
  vec3 m=texelFetch(DiffuseSampler,clamp(first+ivec2(i,j),ivec2(0),size-1),0).rgb;
  // Stable vertex marker: model skins and world light cannot change body temperature.
  float gr=m.g/max(m.r,.00001),br=m.b/max(m.r,.00001);
  if(m.r>.995 && gr>.825 && gr<.865 && br>.003 && br<.015){
   background=max(background,rad(310.));body=1.;
  }
  bool hull=m.r>=.5 && abs(m.b-26./255.)<.0015;
  int role=int(round(m.b*255.));
  bool vehicle=m.r>=.5 && role>=26 && role<=32;
  bool warmBody=m.r>=.5 && abs(m.b-46./255.)<.0015;
  bool living=warmBody || (m.r>=.5 && abs(m.b-47./255.)<.0015);
  bool missile=m.r>=.5 && role==48;
  if(vehicle || living || missile){
   if(vehicle)vehicleFound=true;
   float temperature=200.+((m.r*255.-128.)*256.+m.g*255.)/32767.*1200.;
   if(hull || role==27 || role==28 || role==30 || role==31 || role==32){
    for(int k=0;k<32;k++)if(k<VehicleCount){
     vec3 delta=position-vec3(VehicleCenters[k*4],VehicleCenters[k*4+1],VehicleCenters[k*4+2]);
     vec4 q=vec4(-VehicleRotations[k*4],-VehicleRotations[k*4+1],-VehicleRotations[k*4+2],VehicleRotations[k*4+3]);
     vec3 local=delta+2.*cross(q.xyz,cross(q.xyz,delta)+q.w*delta);
     if(role==28){
      vec3 sensor=vec3(VehicleSensors[k*4],VehicleSensors[k*4+1],VehicleSensors[k*4+2]);
      vec3 d=(local-sensor)/vec3(.85,.65,.85);
      if(length(local-sensor)>8.5)continue;
      temperature+=VehicleSensors[k*4+3]*(.045+.90*exp(-length(d)*.75));break;
     }
     local.x-=VehicleAxes[k*4];local.z-=VehicleAxes[k*4+1];
     float width=VehicleAxes[k*4+2],height=VehicleAxes[k*4+3],halfLength=VehicleCenters[k*4+3];
     // Mounted parts inherit heat across the edge; there is no hard cold-box cutoff.
     vec3 outside=max(vec3(abs(local.x)-width,-local.y,abs(local.z)-halfLength),vec3(0));
     outside.y=max(outside.y,local.y-height);
     if(length(outside)>3.)continue;
     float attachment=exp(-length(outside)*1.4);
     vec3 grid=clamp(vec3((local.x/width+1.)*4.,local.y/height*8.,(1.-local.z/halfLength)*12.),vec3(0),vec3(8,8,24));
     ivec3 base=min(ivec3(floor(grid)),ivec3(7,7,23));vec3 f=grid-vec3(base);float rise=0.;
     for(int z=0;z<2;z++)for(int y=0;y<2;y++)for(int x=0;x<2;x++){
      ivec3 node=base+ivec3(x,y,z);float weight=(x==0?1.-f.x:f.x)*(y==0?1.-f.y:f.y)*(z==0?1.-f.z:f.z);
      vec2 field=texelFetch(VehicleFieldSampler,ivec2((node.z*9+node.y)*9+node.x,k),0).rg;
      rise+=weight*(role==27?field.g:field.r);
     }
     // Thin shields and reflective glazing do not share a thick steel panel's response.
     rise*=attachment;
     if(role==30)rise*=.72;
     if(role==31)rise=rise*.25-3.;
     temperature+=rise;break;
    }
   }
   if(vehicle && role!=27)vehicleGlare=max(vehicleGlare,max(temperature-t-25.,0.)*.006);
   entityRadiance=max(entityRadiance,rad(temperature));entityFound=true;
   if(living)body=max(body,warmBody&&temperature>=300.?1.:clamp((temperature-t)/18.,0.,1.));
  }
  else if(m.r>.008 && m.g/m.r<.4 && m.b/m.r<.05)
   background=max(background,rad(330.+250.*clamp(1.-(m.g/m.r-.02)/.32,0.,1.)));
 }
 if(entityFound)background=entityRadiance;
 vec4 gas=texture(HeatSampler,uv);
 float transmission=exp(-max(gas.a,0.));
 float opacity=1.-transmission;
 float source=gas.r/max(gas.a,.00001);
 float signal=background*transmission+source*opacity;
 fragColor=vec4(signal,gas.g/max(gas.a,.00001)*opacity+vehicleGlare*transmission,(body>0.?body:vehicleFound?-1.:0.)*transmission,max(opacity,smoothstep(1.,12.,warmed)));
}

#version 150
uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D MaterialSampler;
uniform float Temperatures[64];
uniform sampler2D ClimateSampler;
uniform vec2 ClimateOrigin;
uniform vec2 CameraXZ;
uniform float CameraBiome;
uniform float ShadeTemperatures[64];
in vec2 localXZ;
in float skyExposure;
in vec2 texCoord;
in vec3 faceNormal;
in float heightOffset;
out vec4 fragColor;
void main(){
 vec4 skin=texture(Sampler0,texCoord);if(skin.a<.1)discard;
 int material=clamp(int(texture(MaterialSampler,texCoord).r+.5),0,63);
 float t=mix(ShadeTemperatures[material],Temperatures[material],skyExposure)-heightOffset*.0065;
 if(t<400.)t+=(texture(ClimateSampler,(localXZ+CameraXZ-ClimateOrigin)/2048.).r-CameraBiome)*6.;
 // Small, stable directional emissivity contrast preserves faces without visible-light shadows.
 t+=dot(normalize(faceNormal+vec3(.00001)),normalize(vec3(.4,.8,.3)))*1.2;
 float code=clamp((t-200.)/1200.,0.,1.)*32767.;
 fragColor=vec4((128.+floor(code/256.))/255.,mod(code,256.)/255.,82./255.,1.);
}

#version 150
in vec3 Position;
in vec2 UV0;
in vec3 Normal;
in ivec2 UV2;
uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;
uniform vec3 ChunkOffset;
out vec2 texCoord;
out vec3 faceNormal;
out float heightOffset;
out vec2 localXZ;
out float skyExposure;
void main(){vec3 p=Position+ChunkOffset;gl_Position=ProjMat*ModelViewMat*vec4(p,1.);texCoord=UV0;faceNormal=Normal;heightOffset=p.y;localXZ=p.xz;skyExposure=clamp(float(UV2.y)/240.,0.,1.);}

File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/tube_tv.fsh

#version 150

// Kh-59M Tube-2A: day B&W cubes; dusk snow ramps in; night full static.
// SkyLight 1 = noon, 0 = midnight (world clock).

uniform sampler2D DiffuseSampler;
uniform vec2 OutSize;
uniform float Time;
uniform float SkyLight;
uniform float BlockLight;
uniform float Flash;

in vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 fragColor;

float hash(vec2 p) {
    return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453123);
}

float luma(vec3 c) {
    return dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
}

float chromaY(vec3 c) {
    float y = luma(c);
    float chroma = max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)) - min(c.r, min(c.g, c.b));
    return clamp(y + chroma * 0.35, 0.0, 1.0);
}

float sampleY(vec2 uv) {
    return chromaY(texture(DiffuseSampler, uv).rgb);
}

float softY(vec2 uv) {
    vec2 t = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
    return (
        sampleY(uv) * 2.0 +
        sampleY(uv + vec2(t.x, 0.0)) +
        sampleY(uv - vec2(t.x, 0.0)) +
        sampleY(uv + vec2(0.0, t.y)) +
        sampleY(uv - vec2(0.0, t.y)) +
        sampleY(uv + t * 0.7) +
        sampleY(uv - t * 0.7) +
        sampleY(uv + vec2(t.x, -t.y) * 0.7) +
        sampleY(uv + vec2(-t.x, t.y) * 0.7)
    ) / 10.0;
}

float edgeY(vec2 uv) {
    vec2 t = 1.0 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
    float n = sampleY(uv + vec2(0.0, -t.y));
    float s = sampleY(uv + vec2(0.0, t.y));
    float e = sampleY(uv + vec2(t.x, 0.0));
    float w = sampleY(uv + vec2(-t.x, 0.0));
    float gx = e - w;
    float gy = n - s;
    return sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
}

float fineEdgeY(vec2 uv) {
    vec2 t = 0.5 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0));
    float n = sampleY(uv + vec2(0.0, -t.y));
    float s = sampleY(uv + vec2(0.0, t.y));
    float e = sampleY(uv + vec2(t.x, 0.0));
    float w = sampleY(uv + vec2(-t.x, 0.0));
    float gx = e - w;
    float gy = n - s;
    return sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
}

void main() {
    vec2 uv = texCoord;

    float day = clamp(SkyLight, 0.0, 1.0);
    // Full snow below ~0.22; ramps in from ~0.65 (dusk). Noon stays clean.
    float nightAmt = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.20, 0.62, day);

    vec2 jitter = (vec2(
        hash(vec2(Time * 17.0, uv.y * 97.0)),
        hash(vec2(uv.x * 83.0, Time * 23.0))
    ) - 0.5) * (1.15 / max(OutSize, vec2(1.0)));
    vec2 sampleUv = uv + jitter * mix(0.35, 1.0, 1.0 - nightAmt * 0.5);

    vec3 rgb = texture(DiffuseSampler, sampleUv).rgb;
    float rawY = chromaY(rgb);
    float blurY = softY(sampleUv);
    float edge = edgeY(sampleUv);
    bool isSky = rawY > 0.70;

    float y = clamp(rawY * 1.12, 0.0, 1.0);
    y = (y - 0.5) * 1.32 + 0.5;
    y += (rawY - blurY) * 3.55;
    if (!isSky) {
        y += edge * 0.92 + fineEdgeY(sampleUv) * 0.36;
        y = min(y, 0.78);
        y = max(y, 0.11);
        if (rawY < 0.03) {
            y = max(y, 0.11);
        }
    } else {
        y = clamp(mix(0.52, 0.88, rawY), 0.0, 0.88);
    }
    float dayG = clamp(y, 0.0, 1.0);
    dayG += (hash(uv * OutSize + Time * 53.0) - 0.5) * mix(0.038, 0.012, nightAmt);

    float snowA = hash(uv * OutSize + Time * 61.0);
    float snowB = hash(uv * OutSize * 1.73 + Time * 29.0);
    float snowC = hash(floor(uv * OutSize * 0.45) + floor(Time * 22.0));
    float boil = mix(step(0.50, snowA), step(0.46, snowB), 0.5);
    boil = mix(boil, step(0.50, snowC), 0.30);
    float flicker = 0.78 + 0.22 * hash(vec2(Time * 17.0, floor(uv.y * OutSize.y)));
    float nightG = mix(0.02, 1.0, boil) * flicker;
    float emitter = smoothstep(0.58, 0.82, rawY);
    nightG = mix(nightG, clamp(0.50 + rawY * 0.60, 0.0, 1.0), emitter * (0.55 + 0.45 * blurY));

    float g = mix(dayG, nightG, nightAmt);

    float flash = clamp(Flash, 0.0, 1.0);
    g = mix(g, 1.0, flash * 0.90);

    float scan = 0.972 + 0.028 * sin(uv.y * OutSize.y * 3.14159 + Time * 8.0);
    g *= mix(scan, 0.988 + 0.012 * sin(uv.y * OutSize.y * 2.5 + Time * 5.0), 1.0 - nightAmt);

    float band = abs(fract(uv.y * 0.85 + Time * 0.07) - 0.5);
    g *= 1.0 - (1.0 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.06, band)) * mix(0.04, 0.12, nightAmt);

    vec2 vc = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    float vig = 1.0 - dot(vc, vc) * mix(0.16, 0.28, nightAmt);
    g *= clamp(vig, 0.58, 1.0);

    g = floor(clamp(g, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) / 255.0;
    fragColor = vec4(vec3(g), 1.0);
}

File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/core/vehicle_lod.fsh
================================================
#version 150
uniform float DhDepthReversed;
bool cmDhSurface(float depth){return DhDepthReversed>.5 ? depth>.0000001 : depth<.9999995;}
uniform sampler2D DhDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D ModelSampler;
uniform sampler2D VanillaDepthSampler;
uniform sampler2D BeforeNativeDepthSampler;
uniform mat4 VanillaInvViewProjMat;
uniform float VanillaLimit;
uniform mat4 DhInvViewProjMat;
uniform vec2 ScreenSize;
uniform float ThermalMode;
in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec3 cameraRelativePos;
in vec2 texCoord;
out vec4 fragColor;
void main() {
    vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / max(ScreenSize, vec2(1.0));
    float distance = length(cameraRelativePos);
    float nearDepth=texture(VanillaDepthSampler,uv).r;
    float beforeDepth=texture(BeforeNativeDepthSampler,uv).r;
    bool nativeTerrain=VanillaLimit>0.0 && nearDepth<1.0 && abs(nearDepth-beforeDepth)>1e-7;
    float coverage=vertexColor.a;
    // Only pixels changed by the native solid pass contain native depth.
    // Chunk readiness says nothing about who wrote the depth at this pixel.
    if (nativeTerrain) {
        if (nearDepth < 1.0) {
            vec4 p = VanillaInvViewProjMat * vec4(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, nearDepth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
            if (abs(p.w) > 1e-7 && length(p.xyz / p.w) + 0.3 < distance) discard;
        }
    }
    float depth = texture(DhDepthSampler, uv).r;
    if (!nativeTerrain && cmDhSurface(depth)) {
        vec4 h = DhInvViewProjMat * vec4(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, depth * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);
        vec3 terrain = h.xyz / max(abs(h.w), 1e-6);
        // Limited bias for coarser terrain, rather than drawing through hills.
        float tolerance = clamp(1.0 + distance * 0.0015, 1.0, 4.0);
        if (length(terrain) + tolerance < distance) discard;
    }
    // Stable screen-door coverage avoids transparent cuboid sorting and extra draws.
    int x=int(gl_FragCoord.x)&3, y=int(gl_FragCoord.y)&3;
    int bayer[16]=int[16](0,8,2,10,12,4,14,6,3,11,1,9,15,7,13,5);
    if(coverage<(float(bayer[y*4+x])+.5)/16.0)discard;
    vec4 material=texture(ModelSampler,texCoord);
    if(material.a<.1)discard;
    if(ThermalMode>.5){
        float temperature=200.+vertexColor.r*600.;
        float code=clamp((temperature-200.)/1200.,0.,1.)*32767.;
        // Direct component temperature; tag 29 bypasses the native entity conduction field.
        fragColor=vec4((128.+floor(code/256.))/255.,mod(code,256.)/255.,29./255.,1.);
    }else fragColor = vec4(material.rgb*vertexColor.rgb,1.0);
}

File: assets/cruisemissiles/shaders/include/sodium_thermal.glsl
================================================
uniform sampler2D MaterialSampler;
uniform sampler2D ClimateSampler;
uniform float Temperatures[64];
uniform float ShadeTemperatures[64];
uniform vec2 ClimateOrigin;
uniform vec2 CameraXZ;
uniform float CameraBiome;

vec4 cmTerrainTemperature(vec2 uv,vec3 position,float skyExposure){
    int material=clamp(int(texture(MaterialSampler,uv).r+.5),0,63);
    float t=mix(ShadeTemperatures[material],Temperatures[material],skyExposure)-position.y*.0065;
    if(t<400.)t+=(texture(ClimateSampler,(position.xz+CameraXZ-ClimateOrigin)/2048.).r-CameraBiome)*6.;
    // Compressed Sodium vertices carry no normal; derive the same world-space face direction.
    float faceSign=1.0;
    if(!gl_FrontFacing)faceSign=-1.0;
    vec3 faceNormal=normalize(cross(dFdx(position),dFdy(position))*faceSign+vec3(.00001));
    t+=dot(faceNormal,normalize(vec3(.4,.8,.3)))*1.2;
    float code=clamp((t-200.)/1200.,0.,1.)*32767.;
    return vec4((128.+floor(code/256.))/255.,mod(code,256.)/255.,82./255.,1.);
}
